result_kind: simulated (behavioural model B with T-extracted corner parameters compared against the short transistor-level transient; DR-001 item 3)

acceptance_gates.inband_power_3db: |10*log10(P_inband_B/P_inband_T)| <= 3.0 dB -- DR-001's tolerance verbatim, applied to the computable ancestor of its in-band SNDR leg
acceptance_gates.fixed_when: fixed before any corner other than tt was run; tt was inspected while the metrics were designed and that inspection is disclosed here

dr001_acceptance: incomplete at every corner: the in-band SNDR leg is not computable at the committed T record length (sndr_inband_db.reason). A corner whose computable legs all pass is reported 'incomplete', never 'passed': DR-001 item 3 acceptance needs both legs. Lengthening the T record or changing the 3 dB tolerance is a new decision record.

corners.amplitude_note: the T bench drove spec row 11's 0.5*VREF (-6 dBFS nominal); the committed u_diff_v is the analytic tone sample values

sndr_inband_db.reason: 1024 modulator clocks give 5 kHz bins on the bitstream, so the 20 kHz band of spec row 1 is four bins wide while the 4-term Blackman-Harris main lobe (+/- 4 bins) covers all of them: DR-001's lobe-summed signal / in-band-noise split has no in-band noise bins to sum. The decimated route (8 output samples at OSR 128) cannot resolve the band either and its tone is incoherent (3 cycles over 1024 clocks = 3/8 cycle over 8 output samples). sim/modulator-tran/README.md 'What it does not claim' anticipated exactly this; DR-001 flags the short record and the 3 dB tolerance as its first-revisit items. Lengthening the T record or changing the tolerance is a new decision record, not done here.

out_of_band_noise_power.note: auxiliary gross-mismatch detector; not a DR-001 leg

sample_wise_reported_not_gated.why_not_gated: a single-bit loop is chaotic; B and T decorrelate sample-wise within a few clocks whatever the model's quality (sim/modulator-tran/README.md), so these metrics measure the chaos, not the model

inband_power_3db.what: total windowed power in band bins 1..4 (0, 20 kHz] of B over T, same 1024-clock window, same 4-term Blackman-Harris window; the tone is identical by construction

corners.cross_check_status: incomplete: DR-001's in-band-SNDR leg is not computable at the committed 1024-clock T record (see sndr_inband_db.reason), so DR-001 item 3 acceptance cannot be declared at any corner. Computable legs: inband_power_3db, span_10pct, duty_0p05. Model B numbers at this corner are reported uncross-checked and are not used for row 2.
